messages:
maria: Heads-up — console prefetch credit numbers for last 24h vs per-invocation econ are off by ~18%. Anyone seen this pattern before?
aj: Noted. Is this aggregated at the route or tenant level?
maria: Route-level. Compare /chat/stream vs /chat/batch. The console shows much more prefetch credit applied than the econ pipeline reports.
lee: Could be sampling mismatch. Econ pipeline ingests sampled events, console uses full counter from batcher.
sofia: We added a new router tag last week (route_tag) to help with STICKY routing. If that tag isn't carried through the proxy -> telemetry export -> econ pipeline join, attribution can double-count prefetch as route credits.
aj: Any traces? example logs?
lee: quick snippet from proxy logs: 
```
[proxy] req_id=abc123 route=/chat/stream route_tag=sticky-v2 prefetch=true
[exporter] wrote event: req_id=abc123, route=/chat/stream
```
Notice exporter drops route_tag unless `X-Routing-Meta` header present.
sofia: Ah. We rolled change that toggles tagging header off for warmup/burst paths. That would explain why the econ join (which keys by route_tag+req_id) misses matches and falls back to per-model attribution.
maria: So console shows the batcher-level prefetch credits (since batcher reports credits per route_tag at flush), but econ pipeline doesn't correlate them to route because it never sees the tag.
aj: Proposed fix: 1) ensure proxy exports route_tag in telemetry for all prefetch events, 2) add a fallback join in econ pipeline by req_id only when route_tag is absent, 3) add an alert if mismatch > 5%. Thoughts?
lee: Agree on 1 & 2. Fallback join might cause false positives if req_ids reused across tenants. We should scope by tenant_id too.
sofia: We can change the proxy to always set `X-Routing-Meta: route_tag=<value>;tenant=<id>` for prefetch flows. It's a tiny change. I'll open PR.
maria: Can we also add a dashboard diff panel: console_prefetch_credits - econ_attributed_prefetch_credits by route over time? Quick visual to detect regressions.
aj: Yeah, add a per-route delta sparkline with sampling rate annotation. UX: warn when delta > 5% for 3 intervals.
sofia: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/+/2345 — sets header for prefetch, tests included.
lee: For econ pipeline: will add fallback join by (req_id, tenant_id) and tag a confidence flag `attribution_confidence=low` when route_tag missing. Also emit metric econ.join.misses. I'll open an RFC.
maria: Nice. Who owns the console diff panel? ops-analytics or eng-platform?
aj: ops-analytics owns panels but eng-platform will ship the delta metric. I'll pair with @sofia on metric naming.
sofia: Quick note: we should avoid exposing route_tag values in public logs. Masking policy: keep hashes only.
lee: Good call. We'll hash route_tag before export. That won't break joins since both sides will hash the same way.
maria: TL;DR action items: (1) sofia deploy PR to proxy (set header + hash route_tag), (2) lee update econ pipeline join + emit econ.join.misses + attribution_confidence flag, (3) aj create console diff panel with alert rule.
sofia: Deploy bot: starting canary deploy for proxy/sha@b7c3
deploy-bot: Deploy started: proxy b7c3 -> canary-1 (10%)
aj: I'll draft the alert runbook: what to do if delta spikes — rollback header change, check sampling rate, look at econ.join.misses.
lee: Timeline: proxy PR merged in ~30m, econ change will be a separate release (etl job) — target later today. Console panel can be staged once metric is available.
maria: Thanks team. Let's reconvene if the delta doesn't fall under 5% after both changes. :thumbsup:
